title_i18n.es: ChatGPT no curó el cáncer de un perro.

excerpt_i18n.en: When an Australian tech entrepreneur with no background in biology or medicine said ChatGPT helped save his dog from cancer, the story spread with the kind of validation Big Tech has long craved: proof that AI will revolutionize medicine and take on one of its deadliest diseases. The reality, as usual, is more complicated. The […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一位没有生物学或医学背景的澳大利亚科技企业家声称ChatGPT帮助他的狗战胜了癌症，这个故事以科技巨头们长久以来渴望的那种验证方式传播开来：人工智能将彻底改变医疗保健的证据。
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando un empresario tecnológico australiano sin formación en biología o medicina afirmó que ChatGPT ayudó a salvar a su perro del cáncer, la historia se difundió con la clase de validación que la Gran Tecnología ha anhelado durante mucho tiempo: la prueba de que la IA revolucionará la medicina.

items.title: Tmux-IDE, OSS agent-first terminal IDE
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, Small OSS project that i created for myself and want to share with the community. It's a declarative, scriptable, terminal-based IDE focussed on agentic engineering. That's a lot of jargon, but essentially its a multi-agent IDE that you start in your terminal. Why is that relevant? Thanks to tmux and SSH, it means that you have a really simple and efficient way to create your own always-on coding setup. Boot into your IDE through ssh, give a prompt to claude and close off your machine. In tmux-ide claude will keep working. The tool is intentionally really lightweight, because I think the power should come from the harnesses that you are working with. items.title: Will my flight have Starlink?
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, If you’ve been lucky enough to be on a flight with Starlink, you understand the hype. It actually works! However, its availability on flights is patchy and hard to predict. So we built a database of all airlines that have rolled out Starlink (beyond just a trial), and a flight search tool to predict it. Plug in a flight number and date, and we'll estimate the likelihood of Starlink on-board based on aircraft type and tail number. If you don’t have any trips coming up, you can also look up specific routes to see what flights offer Starlink. You can find it here: https://stardrift.ai/starlink . - I wanted to add a few notes on how this works too. items.title: Introducing Nova Forge SDK, a seamless way to customize Nova models for enterprise AI
items.raw_excerpt: Today, we are launching Nova Forge SDK that makes LLM customization accessible, empowering teams to harness the full potential of language models without the challenges of dependency management, image selection, and recipe configuration and eventually lowering the barrier of entry.

title_i18n.en: Introducing Nova Forge SDK, a seamless way to customize Nova models for enterprise AI
title_i18n.zh: 推出Nova Forge SDK，为企业AI定制Nova模型提供无缝解决方案。
title_i18n.es: Presentamos Nova Forge SDK, una forma fluida de personalizar los modelos Nova para la inteligencia artificial empresarial.

excerpt_i18n.en: Today, we are launching Nova Forge SDK that makes LLM customization accessible, empowering teams to harness the full potential of language models without the challenges of dependency management, image selection, and recipe configuration and eventually lowering the barrier of entry.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 今日，我们推出Nova Forge SDK，它使大语言模型定制化变得触手可及，助力团队充分发挥语言模型的潜力，无需应对依赖管理、镜像选择与配置的挑战。
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy lanzamos Nova Forge SDK, que hace accesible la personalización de LLM, permitiendo a los equipos aprovechar todo el potencial de los modelos de lenguaje sin los desafíos de la gestión de dependencias, la selección de imágenes y las recetas.
